claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA.

claims.quote: This will bring investment and good jobs, giving young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.
claims.statement: The Derby headquarters will bring investment and good jobs, giving young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers - with Derby at the heart of its future.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission, better services for passengers, with Derby at the heart of its future.

claims.quote: With 600 apprenticeships opening up, we’re investing not just in the railway of tomorrow, but in the people who will build it.
claims.statement: The 600 apprenticeships are an investment in the people who will build the railway of tomorrow.

claims.quote: This foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the sector at an exciting time, developing their technical knowledge and skillset while earning.
claims.statement: The foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the rail sector while earning.

claims.quote: This forms part of our £2.5 billion youth employment support package which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
claims.statement: The announcement that Great British Railways will be based in Derby is fantastic news for Derby.

claims.quote: Young people should have the chance to learn new skills and build a career in an industry with such deep roots here, without feeling they have to move away to find those opportunities.
claims.statement: Young people should have the chance to learn new skills and build a career in the rail industry in the region without having to move away.

claims.quote: The new HQ will bring hundreds of rail jobs to the city and an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy
claims.statement: The new HQ will bring hundreds of rail jobs to Derby and an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy.

claims.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.
claims.statement: Construction of the GBR headquarters at Becketwell is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
claims.statement: The Becketwell site will accommodate up to 450 Great British Railways staff.

claims.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
claims.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years as a result of bringing operators' services into public ownership.

claims.quote: 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network
claims.statement: 76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the rail network.

claims.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
claims.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship, with the first starters based in Derby.

entities.name: Andy Burnham

facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters at Becketwell in Derby has been unveiled.

facts.statement: Claire Ward, Mayor of the East Midlands, made a statement welcoming the headquarters for Derby.

facts.statement: A £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north is set to be built at Alstom's Derby site.

facts.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.
